decision.memory: Sat 13 afternoon, outside shop in town. Calendar confirms Egg Festival today, but normal town scene persists. Five parsnips harvested; Getting Started completed and 100g collected, balance 550g. Advancement requires Farming level 1 and crafting a scarecrow; last observed Farming 0. Seven planted tiles at farm received watering animations today; three unused seeds remain. Rain previously supported growth without manual watering. Numeric slots work when pressed alone: 2 hoe, 3 watering can, 7 seeds. Hover then C uses tools/plants; hover then X interacts/harvests more reliably than clicks.
